purpose: Blank reusable row-card ranking backgrounds and empty-center laurel rank emblems for home leaderboard and full Ranking page.

rawSeeds.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production game UI asset for Battle Cities, extracted/recreated from approved ranking reference image 1.
Create ONE completely BLANK first-place GOLD ranking row background. Reference only the gold row's material, restrained bevel and shape, not the medals, portraits, text or numbers on it. Wide horizontal rounded rectangle, approximate visible aspect ratio 7.5:1. Straight-on orthographic, symmetric rounded corners, slim warm gold outer lip and bright pale-yellow inner hairline like reference; cream-yellow to warm yellow gold face, clean and light enough for dark navy text. Restrained illustrated toy-metal/game UI polish, light from upper left, no photorealism. A quiet smooth face; no localized reflection, seams or illustration in the long center. Thin identical continuous horizontal top/bottom rims, useful for horizontal 9-slice stretching; endcaps contain all corner curvature. The entire center must be completely empty.
Technical: one isolated horizontal card on genuinely transparent RGBA background with a narrow transparent safety margin and all edges intact. Fill most of width. No bolts, medallions, wreath, rank box, portrait holder, avatar, icons, letters, digits, baked names, score or matches, labels, watermark, shadows extending far outside, surrounding UI or extra objects. No table or composite sheet. Only the single blank GOLD row skin.
rawSeeds.role: Gold row seed revised for flatter corners before final family

normalization: Alpha <8 removed; alpha >=248 made opaque; central connected silhouette retained; trimmed; row skins normalized to common 760x104 visible region on 768x112 RGBA canvas with 4px padding; laurel aspect fit to 240px on 256px square with 8px minimum padding. No recoloring, content painting or lettering added in normalization.

imports.compression: Uncompressed; explicit RGBA32 WebGL and Android overrides

rows.text: All rank, player, score and matches text native; do not use a whole-image stretch for corners.

laurels.rankText: Native overlay at plaque center; no rank digit in asset

usage.portraits: Reuse BattleResultsArt commander portraits; none generated.
usage.spacing: Keep row cards inset from containing border; add visible vertical navy gaps. Padding belongs to layout, not baked into backgrounds.

assets.name: row-gold
assets.prompt: Edit image 1 blank GOLD Battle Cities row background to match the RECTANGULAR row silhouette in reference image 2 more closely. Preserve its clean gold color face, illustrated polish and transparency. Change ONLY geometry and rim: much flatter horizontal rounded RECTANGLE, visible width to height about 7.5:1. Corner radius is ONLY 18% of the card's height, NOT 50%; the left and right sides each have a long straight vertical middle segment covering about 64% of height. Squared soft corners, NOT capsule/pill ends. Slimmer tasteful rim, outer warm gold edge plus fine bright inner hairline. All lighting uniform and restrained along the long blank center; horizontal top and bottom edges straight. Blank stretchable skin for horizontal nine-slicing. One isolated empty card on genuine transparent RGBA with small safety margin, no text, digits, medals, portraits, rank box, bolts, icons, surrounding UI, backdrop or other objects. Do not copy any text from image 2.

assets.name: laurel-gold
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production Battle Cities rank emblem, referencing the approved first-place laurel badge in input image 1.
Create ONE isolated GOLD LAUREL RANK EMBLEM with a completely EMPTY smooth central face for a native rank digit to be added at runtime. NO DIGITS or letters. Front-facing, vertically balanced, compact near-square silhouette. A small rounded gold shield/medallion plaque encircled along its left, bottom and right by a symmetrical gold laurel wreath; leaves sweep upward and leave the upper center open, like first-place badge in reference. Thick readable broad leaves at 36–44 logical pixel display. Clear central blank yellow-gold plaque, bright enough for navy digit overlay, no engraved features. Friendly illustrated polished gold metal matching Battle Cities gold UI, warm amber recessed edges, pale-yellow upper-left highlights, restrained shadows within object.
Technical: single emblem centered, full silhouette intact, genuinely transparent RGBA background, small safety margin, no backdrop or card. No rank digit, number, lettering, star, crown, wings, separate ribbons, portrait, trophy, circular text, watermark or mockup. EMPTY blank center is critical.
